rows.subject: رَّبِّهِۦ
rows.because: تَابَ عَلَيْهِ — the tawba, the TURNING itself: one identified relational standing re-grounded (wrath conceded, mercy begun) — the re-zero on a single bond, Generate·Interpretation at figure grain

rows.subject: إِنَّهُۥ
